post.title: China's retail sales grew just 0.4%. Japan shrank too
post.ig:
China's retail sales grew just 0.4% from last October.
China's October retail sales rose 0.4% year on year, down from 1.1% in September and below the roughly 0.8% economists expected (National Bureau of Statistics, released Nov 16, 2026).
Japan's economy shrank at a 0.1% annualized pace in July-September, its first contraction in a year, as private consumption fell 0.3% from the prior quarter, a second straight quarterly drop (Cabinet Office).
In the US, consumer spending is about two-thirds of the economy (BEA data via FRED).
Sources: China NBS, Japan Cabinet Office, Reuters, Euronews, ING, FRED (Nov 2026).
